title: Progress
description: An append-only execution log for one attempt of a plan, at docs/plans/<plan-name>/progress/<plan-number>-attempt-<n>-<date>.md, written during implementation, not planning, where <n> is one higher than the highest attempt already in progress/. Opened before the first code change and committed alongside the milestone work it records: existing entries are never edited, condensed, or deleted (corrections are appended as new entries), and commits carrying progress entries are never amended or force-pushed. If an attempt is abandoned, the branch and progress log are kept and opened as a pull request stating what was attempted, where it broke, and what the next attempt should do differently

PlanNumber.description: The sequence number of the plan this attempt executes

Attempt.description: The 1-based attempt number, one higher than the highest attempt already recorded in progress/

Started.description: The day the attempt was opened

Status.description: The lifecycle state of the execution attempt

ImplementingAgentInstructions.description: How the implementing agent works, completion criteria, verification, and progress-log obligations, with no placeholders

Entries.description: The chronological, append-only checkpoint entries recorded during the attempt

Entry.description: One immutable checkpoint entry appended to the progress log

Summary.description: What was attempted, what the evidence showed, and what was decided or changed

Verification.description: The verification command or test suite run and its concrete outcome

Commit.description: The git commit hash anchored to the checkpoint, when recorded

examples.implementingAgentInstructions: Open progress/004-attempt-1-2026-11-19.md before the first edit and run dotnet test -c Release after each milestone.

entries.title: Milestone M1 — DryRunProducer and unit test coverage
